category_title: Students with mild intellectual disabilities showing academic engagement, off-task, and problem behaviors
scenario_title: Problem behaviors and active disruption in inclusive classrooms
minimal_context: The student is expected to copy notes from the board during a Social Studies lesson in an inclusive classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's begin our Social Studies lesson. Please look at the board and copy the notes into your notebook.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns around to the desk behind) Did you watch the cartoon on TV this morning?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please pay attention to the lesson and start writing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up from the desk and reaches over) I'm going to use your red pencil.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to sit back down and do your own assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts walking around the classroom, talking aloud) I don't want to write! Hey, look at this pencil I got! (Pokes another student's arm)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's begin our Social Studies lesson. Please look at the board and copy the notes into your notebook.

STUDENT: (Turns around to the desk behind) Did you watch the cartoon on TV this morning?

TUTOR: Please pay attention to the lesson and start writing.

STUDENT: (Stands up from the desk and reaches over) I'm going to use your red pencil.

TUTOR: You need to sit back down and do your own assignment.

STUDENT: (Starts walking around the classroom, talking aloud) I don't want to write! Hey, look at this pencil I got! (Pokes another student's arm)

task.content: Participating in Turkish and Social Studies courses

context.environment: Inclusive classrooms, with students sitting in the front desks or back rows
context.social_setting: Inclusive classrooms in which there were students with mild intellectual disabilities

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Talking to friends irrelevant to the lesson, talking aloud, disturbing friends, hitting friends, taking her/his friends’ possessions without permission, walking in the class, standing up without permission, or acting against the teachers’ instructions

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Behaviors that interrupt the lesson, disturbing or distracting the teacher or other students
